latestVersion.changelog:
ai-subtitle-extension 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Generate and extend subtitles for videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) using cloud GPUs, with quick 1080p MP4 export.
- Automatic token and session management for easy setup (100 free credits, 7-day expiry for new users).
- Supports user workflows: upload, generate/edit subtitles, preview timeline, and export — all through simple prompts.
- Provides timeline summaries and handles batch or iterative edits.
- Detailed error handling and tips included for a smooth user experience.
